result.brief: 提出 AVPS-360 空间音视频基准，用一阶 Ambisonics 音频配 360° 视频做发声人物实例分割与跟踪，并提供音视特征融合基线。
result.reason: Spatial audio-visual benchmark for instance segmentation/tracking of sound-producing persons; no video generation, world model, or representation learning contribution, only a baseline fusing audio-visual features.
